g.text: Mac, 16 GB M4: this engine 3.3x to 3.8x faster decode, 8x to 10x faster first token, not like for like:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: about 3-bit pack with MTP (internal SSD + ~11 GB a request from USB4) against 4.25-bit IQ4_XS, plain decoding, all from USB4

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: PC, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB (launcher's 4-bit pack): llama.cpp is faster, at decode and more so at reading the prompt

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Same model, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; quality not compared. Mac, 2026-11-06, one run per cell: this engine ran a mixed 4/2-bit pack (16.1 GB,

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: about 3 bits) with the model's MTP head, from the internal SSD plus about 11 GB a request from a partial copy on the external USB4 SSD;

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: llama.cpp b11719 ran unsloth's IQ4_XS (17.7 GB, about 4.25 bits) from that external SSD alone, the best of its CPU and hybrid modes

text.style: font-size: 7.6px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: (first token: hybrid). PC: this engine ran the launcher's plan and published 4-bit pack (experts in VRAM plus pinned host RAM, cache bias
